paper_metadata.title: Improved microstructure and mechanical properties of Nb-Si in situ composites: Focus on interstitial element B doping, atomic diffusion and dislocation behaviors

evidence.quote: To reveal the strength-ductility mechanism of Nb-Si based alloys, the microstructure, mechanics properties and dislocation behaviors have been researched in a series of Nb-16Si-24Zr- x B alloys.
